title: Finalize a submitted order
objective: Confirm that finalization reaches FINALIZED state and provides the required visible confirmation.
preconditions: A synthetic order exists in SUBMITTED state.

test_data.name: submitted order
test_data.description: A synthetic order currently shown in SUBMITTED state.

steps.expected_result: The order state changes to FINALIZED and a visible confirmation is shown.

postconditions: The synthetic order is in FINALIZED state.
cleanup: Remove the synthetic order using an approved test-environment procedure.
notes: Selected implementation evidence changes the state but does not expose the visible confirmation required by ORD-008.
